claim_boundary: fresh fixed-weight matched-target state collection for external decoder tracking; no internal adaptation, routing, learning, or causal mechanism claim
matched_target_rule: For every base binary history s, heldout order receives symbols [s1,s0,s2,s4,s3,s5]. Each symbol remains paired with the same reliability as in base order, so public evidence pairs and log-odds targets are identical while cue sequence position changes.
controls: All 64 histories per order/seed/checkpoint; base-order stratified train32/eval32 split; analytic latest-cue and matched conditional-label shuffle. No heldout-order state or evaluation history fits an object.
decision_rule: Within-order delay2/delay8 uses the prior all-cell criterion. The primary matched-target question is strict heldout-order performance of the unchanged base decoder/tracker, reported against identity, scalar-scale, analytic latest-cue and shuffle. This separates target mismatch from coordinate transport but does not establish a causal channel mechanism.
